definitions.short: a missile (spear or arrow); also a quarry (whence stones are, as it were, ejected )
definitions.full: H4551. macca ' I. מַסֶּע noun [masculine] quarry or quarrying ; — only absolute as adverb accusative, מַסָּע שְׁלֵמָה אֶבֶן 1Kin 6:7 stone perfect (at the) quarry (or at quarrying , i.e. when it was quarried; compare Benz; text dubious). II. נסע (√ of following; possibly Arabic throw ( puncture, wound , etc.), Kam Frey, so Buhl 13 ). II. מַסָּע missile, dart ; — only absolute Job 41:18 (+ שִׁרְיָה חֲנִית, ).
